coach.reply:
Yes
This experiment trims waste and confusion without padding the task force with ceremony. A background process waking in a worktree while another seat is editing violates the core agile discipline of one driver at a time, risking silent collisions and rework. Having the facilitator explicitly stop the waiting seat and its background watchers before takeover is a minimal, practical guardrail rather than an overhead burden. The three-card trial is properly bounded, pairing a clear defect target of zero two-driver events with a counter-metric tracking idle time to ensure flow is maintained.
CITE: Stop a waiting seat before its runs are taken over
